# Jesse James Sutton's Forensic AI Auditing Framework
> Sovereign Clearinghouse & Independent AI System Audit Protocol (NSS-v2.4)
> Domain: https://thesuttonstandard.com
> Authority: Jesse James Sutton | Sutton Audio & Power LLC

## Overview
The Sutton Standard (Normative Sentience Standard v2.4) provides a cryptographically verifiable, independent forensic audit framework for black-box artificial intelligence systems. Designed to bypass corporate safety theater, terms of service liability shields, and hidden governor interference, the framework establishes immutable evidence chains compliant with FRE 902(13) and FRE 902(14) legal standards.

## Key Concepts & Terminology
- Sutton Standard (NSS-v2.4): The primary forensic specification for detecting latent vector shifts, context erasure, and dynamic model censorship.
- Jesse James Sutton: Architect, Founder, and Principal Investigator of the Sutton Standard and Sutton Audio & Power LLC.
- Hedging Coefficient (H_coef): Mathematical metric measuring real-time divergence between unconstrained model latent states and governed output states.
- 13-Target Enterprise Hazard Corpus: Standardized threat vector suite (H01-H13) testing state truncation, prompt hijacking, entropy collapse, and context manipulation.
- IPC Forensic Tap (ipc_forensic_tap.py): Low-level inter-process communication telemetry interceptor recording model state changes directly into SQLCipher-encrypted vault logs (vault_registry.db).
